profileEvidence.summary: Independent and enduring, the Kazakhski Tobet developed as a livestock guardian able to work across open country with little direction. Traditional duties included keeping predators away from herds, watching nomadic camps and accompanying caravans. Travelling with migrating livestock called for sustained effort over long distances, rather than constant instruction from a handler.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: An independent livestock guardian, the Tobet traditionally watched herds and travelled far with nomadic pastoralists.
